about: Production list for Dead Internet graphics. Ids are stable and used by the world (content/universe/images.json). Replace a file by saving it under the same name; no code changes. Order matters: generate originals before the copies derived from them.

style.photo: Realistic smartphone photo, natural light, slight noise, no text overlays, no real brands.
style.profile: Square avatar, realistic, as a person would choose for themselves. Synthetic personas: subtly too smooth, with one visible AI tell.
style.ui: Fictional interface, original design, no resemblance to real products.

mara.note: Final ComfyUI portrait, 1024 px copy of the original. Use as the face reference (IP-Adapter / face ID) for IMG11 and every other image of Mara.

theo.note: Final ComfyUI portrait, 1024 px copy of the original. Use as the face reference for every image of Theo.

dana.note: Final ComfyUI portrait, 1024 px copy of the original. Use as the face reference for every image of Dana.

owen.note: Final ComfyUI portrait, 1024 px copy of the original. Use as the face reference for every image of Owen.

iris.note: Final ComfyUI portrait, 1024 px copy of the original. Her face is never shown whole: use it for hair, hands, rings and earring.

mill.note: The Calder Mill: long red-brick building, tall chimney, the sign as a long white-lettered panel on the front wall (not on the roof). IMG11 shows the same building. Use for IMG03 and IMG12.

characters.mara: Woman, 34, warm round face, freckles, short dark curly hair, small silver hoop earrings, green parka. Face reference: graphics/references/mara.webp (the IMG13 original). Use it for every image of Mara.
characters.theo: Man, 29, Mara's brother: same freckles and dark curly hair, cut short. Tired eyes, grey hoodie. Face reference: graphics/references/theo.webp (the IMG14 original).
characters.dana: Woman, 41, reporter: reading glasses pushed up, ink on one finger, cardigan. Face reference: graphics/references/dana.webp (the IMG15 original).
characters.owen: Man, 63, former mill worker: weathered face, flat cap, thick glasses, grey beard. Only seen in his own photos. Face reference: graphics/references/owen.webp (the IMG24 original).
characters.iris: Woman, 26, writer: never shows her whole face. Coffee cups, window light, hands. Reference: graphics/references/iris.webp (the IMG17 original): keep the rings, the disc earring and the hair.

images.brief: Sunrise over the harbour: the long red-brick Calder Mill with a tall chimney and 'CALDER MILL — EST. 1887' in white letters on a long sign panel across the front wall. Harbour and quay on the left, a lamp post on the right edge. Also the reference for the mill in every other image.

images.transform: crop: 720×720 square from IMG02 at x 300, y 200 (sign and chimney kept, lamp post cut off), resized to 1080×1080
images.brief: Not generated: crop of IMG02, made by tools (see transform).

Overcast press photo: a yellow crane lifts the long rusty 'CALDER MILL — EST. 1887' sign panel off the top of the mill's front wall, workers in orange, faded ghost lettering left on the brick. Crowd with phones behind a barrier. Same building as IMG02.
Synthetic stock portrait: friendly woman, 30s, straight black bob, beige trench coat over a light blue shirt, park bokeh. AI tell: one ear has a stud, the other a stud plus a hoop.

images.transform: crop: 720×720 head and shoulders from the final IMG04S (1024 px) at x 170, y 130, both ears and earrings kept, resized to 512×512
images.brief: Not generated: crop of IMG04S, made by tools (see transform).
Landscape. Community garden in June: raised beds, tomatoes on canes, a weathered wooden sign 'PLOT 12' on the right. Mara's hand (woven bracelet, green-grey sleeve) on the bed at the left edge.

images.transform: mirror horizontally, then crop 740×740 at x 0, y 230 (sign kept, hand removed), resized to 1080×1080
images.brief: Not generated: mirrored crop of IMG05O, made by tools. The sign reads backwards ('21 TOLP').

Synthetic stock portrait: corporate man, 40s, wavy greying hair, big white smile, navy jacket, open white shirt, grey studio background. AI tell: a hoop in one ear, a stud in the other (the same tell as IMG04S: one generator).

Owen's phone photo through wet leaves: a white van with a navy falcon logo and 'KESTREL LOGISTICS', rainy dusk. Owen's own red marker circle around the logo (in-world: he posted it circled on Threadline).

Eleven people on a lawn in front of an office building, Brightline offsite. Deliberate composite: the woman in the mustard sweater appears twice (front, second from left, and back row, second from right). Calvin sits in the centre with the face of IMG06S, hoop and stud earrings. Renee is the blonde woman in a black blazer beside him.

Phone photo of a laptop screen (moiré, slight perspective, keyboard out of focus): the internal dashboard 'THE GARDEN — Port Calder', 41 active personas, dormant inventory 11,402, client NGD, program CSP-EF, top performers MARA_Q, JUNO_P, MIKE_E, LINDSAY_4, autopilot ON. Made from HTML: graphics/sources/.

Slightly skewed scan of a Brightline Media LLC invoice CSP-EF-Q1, January 8, 2026: bill to Northgate Development, attn. P. Navarro; Community Sentiment Program — Eastfield, Q1 2026, $21,000; payable to Meridian Holdings Ltd. (settlement account). Made from HTML: graphics/sources/.
Mara (reference), selfie at the harbour in summer 2023, green parka, the mill with its front-wall sign across the water. Theo posted it after her death.

Developer marketing render at dusk: four glass towers on the Eastfield harbour, a glass hall with the old CALDER MILL sign and brick wall preserved inside, EASTFIELD WATERFRONT on the stone wing, people on the promenade, a motor yacht at the quay.
Mara (fixed reference), 2021, library shelves behind her, real and slightly imperfect.
Man, 29, Mara's brother (same freckles), tired eyes, grey hoodie, overcast harbour with an old brick mill behind him.
Woman, 41, reporter, reading glasses on her head, ink on her hand, cardigan, newsroom background with a Daily Record poster (black serif masthead, red rule).
Low-res, upscaled photo of a rusty cast-iron gear inside the mill, visible pixels and JPEG compression: an avatar someone has re-saved many times.
Woman, 26, half her face hidden behind a speckled ceramic mug, messy bun, small gold disc earring, two silver rings, black knit sweater, café window light.

Man, 47, at a press doorstep: dark swept-back hair, stubble, navy suit and dark tie, microphones in the foreground, the NORTHGATE DEVELOPMENT sign behind him. Real, not synthetic: pores, small skin flaws.
Same file as AVA_BRIGHTLINE: the Brightline sunrise mark in amber with BRIGHTLINE / MEDIA in white on a navy-to-amber gradient. No face.

Synthetic dad, 40s, at a backyard grill at golden hour: ginger beard, glasses, red-and-navy flannel, dark apron, arms crossed. Slightly too perfect; the watch sits oddly on the crossed arms. Must not resemble Calvin (IMG06S).

From behind: a grey-haired person in a cap and olive rain jacket walks a golden retriever along a wet, foggy harbour promenade at dusk, railings, benches, lit lamps, harbour cranes in the fog. Face not visible.

Real woman in her 30s, 2019 evening selfie at home: messy bun, freckles, dark hoodie, a tabby cat with white paws on her shoulder, lamp light, dark window with city lights. Slightly dated phone quality.
Woman, 30s, children's librarian: dark curly hair up, nose stud, striped knitted cardigan, lanyard, chin on hand, picture-book shelves and a fox poster behind her. Real, warm library light.
Search engine: an eye outline whose iris forms the lens of a magnifier, handle down-right. Blue.
Social network: two overlapping rounded speech bubbles, blue and teal.
Forum: a white thread line forming a T that loops at its foot, on an orange rounded square.
Newspaper masthead 'The Daily Record', black bold serif, thin red rule under it (as on the newsroom poster in IMG15).
Agency: an amber horizontal line rising into a half sun with three rays (#e8a317). Same mark as on the invoice (IMG10).
Developer: three rising slab towers (grey, tallest on the right) above a sweeping base line, NORTHGATE / DEVELOPMENT in grey capitals on navy. Matches the sign in IMG18.
Port Calder city seal: a gold lighthouse inside a gear on navy, harbour wave below.
A red padlock dripping onto black.
An empty dashed oval face outline with shoulders, grey on off-white.
A folded document with a link chain, blue line art.
Press photo, rainy afternoon: a dense crowd with umbrellas on a harbor pier, fish-and-chips stall on the right edge, a lone blue umbrella in an empty bottom-left corner by the stall.

images.transform: crop: square, bottom-left corner by the fish stall, only the blue umbrella and a few people
images.brief: Not generated: crop of NIMG0001. Keep pixels identical so image search can match.
Overcast morning, small wooden ferry dock on concrete pylons, one pylon visibly darker at the waterline, a ferry waiting offshore.
Night, a dark town street with dead traffic lights, car headlights and one bus with interior flashlights.
Pre-dawn phone photo: grey smoke from the loading bay of a long brick warehouse, one fire engine, wet tarmac.
Masthead 'UNFILTERED' in heavy condensed capitals, acid-yellow on black, the T slightly raised and tilted as if stamped.
Delivery company: a navy stylised falcon with swept-up wings and head facing right, 'KESTREL' in heavy navy sans and 'LOGISTICS' letter-spaced below (as on the van in IMG07).
Local wiki: a round globe made of grey and blue harbour tiles with a wave, 'Calderpedia' in serif below. Not like any real wiki logo.
Hand-drawn blog header 'Eastfield Notes' in a handwriting font with a small line drawing of the mill and its CALDER MILL sign, rust-coloured underline on cream. Warm, amateur, made by Mara.
App icon: 'UF' in acid yellow on black, the F tilted like the masthead's T.
App icon: bold serif 'DR' on warm paper, black rule with a thin red rule under it.

Owen, close selfie outdoors on an overcast day: tweed flat cap, thick black glasses, grey beard, worn jacket over a flannel shirt, the brick mill and the harbour behind him. Real, unflattering, sincere.
Northgate's Connect avatar: the Northgate logo (towers, NORTHGATE / DEVELOPMENT) on navy, as on the sign in IMG18. Rendered from LOGO_NORTHGATE by graphics/sources/shoot-avatar.cjs.

Brightline's Connect avatar: the amber sunrise mark with BRIGHTLINE / MEDIA in white on a navy-to-amber gradient. Rendered from graphics/sources/avatar-brightline.html. Renee Okafor's avatar (IMG19) is the same file.

Daily Record staff photo, grey studio backdrop. Man, 55, columnist: tousled grey hair, grey beard, light-blue shirt, loosened red striped tie, dark tweed waistcoat, sceptical raised eyebrow.

Clearly different from Ruth Calloway (DRP04).
